runtime.n_threads: N_THREADS env, else CPU affinity / cgroup quota
runtime.prefix_kv_cache: each static prefix evaluated once at startup; KV state saved and restored per call

parser.grammar: GBNF from the ParsedQuery JSON schema (bahar/llm/parser.py PARSER_SCHEMA)

composer.grammar: per request: refs limited to the facts block, no digit characters in any script
composer.output: markdown answer; every number, time and place as {{e#}} / {{v#}}
validator: number word next to a unit or time word
each labelled line cites only its own section's facts
composer.on_failure: misplaced lines replaced from the template; otherwise one retry if >= 15 s remain, else the template answer
